SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & B. REGISTRY. File No. No. D. 5523 SECTION 2 / SERIAL 23 Date December 7, 1933）

Subject (in full) A.A.Vassilieff, candidate for position of Police Watchman.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by A G Smeart.

With reference to the attached application by
A.A.Vassilieff for a position as Police Watchman, this individu-
al's antecedents and record as known to this office are as fol-
lows:-

Alexander Alexandrovitch Vassilieff, Russian, born
July 21, 1901 at Vladivostock. He arrived in Shanghai from Vla-
divostock via Harbin in October 1925 and has since been residing
in this city. He worked as a chauffeur for some time and from
June 1927 till October, 1933, was employed as a watchman(unarmed)
with various cabarets situated in Rue Chu Pao San, French Conces-
sion, including Charleston Cafe, New Royal Cafe, Cafe Maxime, and
Cafe Rabbit.

Enquiries show that Vassiliev has the reputation of
a man indulging in frequent drinking bouts and ,whilst under the
influence of drink, inclined to be troublesome.

On June 29, 1927, he was charged with assault at the
French Mixed Court and was sentenced to two months imprisonment
(suspended) and fined $ 60.00 for damage.

Apart from the above nothing detrimental is known by
this office against the applicant.

（批：AB）

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
（批：File MS DEC. 7 1933）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处刑事与便衣侦探科档案室。档案号 D. 5523 第2部分 / 序列号 23 日期 1933年12月7日）

事由（全称） A.A.瓦西里耶夫，警员职位候选人。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫撰写。经 A G Smeart 转呈。

关于附呈的 A.A.瓦西里耶夫申请警员职位一事，本处所知的该人背景及记录如下：-

亚历山大·亚历山德罗维奇·瓦西里耶夫，俄国人，1901年7月21日出生于符拉迪沃斯托克。他于1925年10月经哈尔滨从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，此后一直居住在本市。他曾做过一段时间的司机，自1927年6月至1933年10月，受雇于法租界朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）的多家歌舞厅担任（无武装）看守，包括查尔斯顿咖啡馆（Charleston Cafe）、新皇家咖啡馆（New Royal Cafe）、马克西姆咖啡馆（Cafe Maxime）和兔子咖啡馆（Cafe Rabbit）。

查询显示，瓦西里耶夫素有频繁酗酒之名，且在醉酒状态下倾向于惹是生非。

1927年6月29日，他在法公堂被控殴打罪，被判监禁两个月（缓刑），并因损坏财物罚款60.00元。

除上述情况外，本处未发现对该申请人不利的记录。

（批：AB）

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

特别股主管警官。
（批：归档 MS 1933年12月7日）
